description: - `docs/HACKATHON_PLAN.md` — the current build plan (architecture, tech stack, task split, schedule, risk register) for the 20-hour hackathon build. **Read this first.** - `docs/PRD.md` / `docs/TRD.md` / `docs/SRS.md` / `docs/README.md` — the full 9-month pilot requirements the hackathon plan scopes down from. - `backend/` — FastAPI app (MongoDB + Neo4j, the 4-agent pipeline, custody chain, export). - `frontend/` — Next.js 14 app. - `contracts/` — frozen JSON response shapes, also used as the frontend's mock data. - `docker-compose.yml` — MongoDB + Neo4j containers (Ollama and the ASR subprocess stay native; see the plan for why).
